privateListingRow.title: Beautiful 3 bed house in Garsfontein
privateListingRow.description:
This is an ExDev integration test listing. Do not publish publicly. Agent: your test/training use
Welcome to Junoah Estate, a secure, single-storey residential development in the sought-after suburb of Bartlett, Boksburg. Built for modern families and working professionals, it combines comfort, clean design, and everyday convenience in a safe, community-focused setting.

Each home offers three well-sized bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and open-plan living areas that lead out to a private garden with a built-in braai — ideal for entertaining or unwinding at home. The kitchen is fitted with a gas stove and designed for practical, everyday use. Every unit also includes a double garage and quality finishes throughout.

Optional extras such as backup inverter systems and air conditioning allow you to tailor your home to your needs, with added peace of mind during load-shedding. The estate is fully enclosed and features 24-hour security, access control, and electric fencing.

Residents can enjoy a private park within the estate — a quiet, green space for children, families, and relaxed outdoor living. Junoah Estate is also conveniently located close to leading schools, shopping centres, and main transport routes.

answers.question: Are you aware of any electrical faults / problems regarding the electrical installation or appliances?

Are there any illegal electrical extensions, or non-working points and has there been any disconnection or damage, to permanent fixtures / equipment? Eg stoves, oven, extractor fan, aircon, heaters, ceiling fans, light fixtures, water pumps etc...?
Are there any problems regarding the water heater for example: leaks, faulty gaskets, low pressure?
Are there any problems with the drainage system e.g. clogged drainage pipes, drains, storm water drains or gutters?
Are there any leaking taps, pipes, burst pipes or water heating systems not working properly?
Are there keys to all doors?
How many remote controls exist for electronic gates and garage doors?
Are all security systems in good working order e.g. alarms, burglar bars and security gates?

a) Is the pool pump, cleaning equipment and pipes in good working condition (general operation of equipment, pipes or filter, etc) b) Is there any damage to the fibreglass/marbelite and are there any cracks or loose tiles?
Were any repairs done to the items specified in 9 above, over the past six months?
Is there any rising damp in walls in any of the rooms / buildings?
Are there any leaks in the roof?
Are there cracks, leaks or problems with bathtubs, sinks, toilets or showers?
Are there any cracked or broken tiles, damaged wooden floors?
Are there any structural defects which you are aware of for example, cracks in walls or erosion etc?
Is there any damage to the carpets such as stains, burn marks, spots etc?
Are all cupboards in working order and acceptable condition?
Are all door handles, back doors and window locking systems in working order?
Are all the improvements carried out at the property reflected on the approved building plans?
Are you in possession of such approved building plans?

privateListingRow.title: Modern Newlands Apartment with Mountain Views
privateListingRow.description:
This neat little two bedroom cottage is situated on a beautiful flat peace of ground a stones throw away from the beach.

The property is fully walled with an electric gate and has a lovely lush manicured garden.
It consists of a cosy lounge a galley fitted kitchen and two rooms with a newly refurbished bathroom.

This home has huge potential to build on and extend and is a hop skip and jump to the beach.
Add on another story and you will have gorgeous sea views or keep the cottage as a granny flat or guest cottage and build the home of your dreams on the property there is ample space.
